description: Query records from an entity type with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Read-only; enforces Row-Level and Field-Level Security (RLS & FLS). Filtering options: use `whereQuery` (SQL-like condition, e.g. `rating >= 4`) with optional `params` bind map (`:paramName`), OR pass structured `filters` JSON (do not combine conflicting filters). Returns `{ meta: { offset, limit, returned, total? }, items: [...] }`. Call `get_table` first to verify filterable field names.

filters.description: Optional structured JSON filter object (alternative to `whereQuery`).

includeTotal.description: Optional flag to include total matching row count in `meta.total`.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (optional, default 50, max 500).

orderBy.description: Optional sort specification as a JSON array string, e.g. `[{"field":"name","direction":"asc"}]`.

params.description: Optional key-value bind parameters for placeholders in `whereQuery`.

name: read_rows
